item: V2 NU-E: out-of-sample direct-kill validation of the V2 designs under the TEP
acceptance_rule: peaks |Q - T| <= max(0.01, TE); ratios |Q - r| <= TE; TE = |bias| + 2 SE (design-dt: Q = Q(1e-3), bias = Q(dt) - R1; continuum: Q = R1, bias = R2 - R1)

bias_law_check_primary.note: expected Q(dt) - Q(0) = -(dt/2)(1 + gamma t) per peak (first order, gamma = 1)
